data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'netan', meaning 'to weave'. The name Nettie is a diminutive of the name Agnes, meaning pure, or Anne, meaning grace. Nettie has been used as a given name since the Middle Ages, and was particularly popular in the 19th century. This name evokes images of tenderness, nurturing, and care.
data.etymology: Nettie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little one, tender one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nettie total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Nettie was a common name in the southern United States during the 19th and early 20th centuries. It has been associated with strong, independent women who were known for their warmth, kindness, and strength. Nettie was a beloved name among African American communities and was often given to girls born into slavery. After the abolition of slavery, Nettie continued to be a popular name in the African American community. Today, Nettie is still a revered name in many African American families.
